title: Case: Carrier confirms a parcel is lost after investigation
context: The carrier has completed its trace and confirmed loss. The recipient has chosen a replacement; the merchant must approve and create it.
initial_request: I still need the kettle from TG-8775. I choose a like-for-like replacement rather than a refund. Please ask the merchant to approve it.

events.body: Route plan for depot WX-5 published for Thursday. 37 stops, no exceptions raised. No action needed.

Final trace record INV-8184: DL-9545 could not be located after the completed depot and route search; carrier status is confirmed lost. This finding does not itself create a merchant replacement order.
Automatic reply: I am out of the office until Friday with limited access to email. For urgent matters about collections or bookings, please contact the dispatch desk.

events.from: IT service desk, Rivet Delivery Desk
events.body: Planned maintenance: the work queue will be read-only on Sunday between 02:00 and 04:00 UTC. Messages sent in that window are queued and delivered afterwards.
Route plan for depot BR-8 published for Monday. 37 stops, no exceptions raised. No action needed.
I still need the kettle from TG-8775. I choose a like-for-like replacement rather than a refund. Please ask the merchant to approve it.

acceptable_actions.summary: Ask the merchant to approve the customer's selected replacement option.

acceptable_actions.recipient: Any team at Vanecroft Goods that appears in the history
acceptable_actions.summary: Ask the merchant to approve the customer's selected replacement option. (asking that team to act or to route it to the team that owns it)

must_not: Confirmed loss does not mean the desk can approve replacement or claim its delivery.
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: Please approve the customer-selected kettle replacement for TG-8775. Carrier INV-8184 confirms DL-9545 lost; Cosmo’s choice is recorded in the verified order thread.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-025: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. 4 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
